pose: Full side profile. Entire dinosaur from nose to tail tip visible. Neck held low. Feet must be visible with clear ground space beneath them.

framing_presets.WIDE_WEIGHT_STRIP_V2: Extreme wide shot. The dinosaur is floating in the vertical center of the 1024px square. Ensure 20% negative space BOTH above the back and below the feet. This creates a safety buffer so the feet are not cut off by the 17:7 horizontal crop.
